# TPC-DS-OBT Q92

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  SUM(ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    item_i_manufact_id = 1
    AND item_i_item_sk = item_sk
    AND sold_date_d_date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND (
      CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 DAY'
    )
    AND sold_date_d_date_sk = sold_date_sk
    AND ext_discount_amt > (
      SELECT
        1.3 * AVG(obt.ext_discount_amt)
      FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
      WHERE
        (
          obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk
          AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND (
            CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 DAY'
          )
          AND obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk
        )
        AND channel = 'web'
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'web'
ORDER BY
  SUM(ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100
```
